query:
SELECT DISTINCT
            client_session_id AS "client_session_id!: String",
            user_id AS "user_id!: i32"
        FROM client_sessions
        WHERE bear_id = $1
          AND (
              client_session_id = ANY($2::text[])
              OR conversation_id = ANY($3::text[])
              OR resolved_conversation_id = ANY($3::text[])
          )
